title: Annual leave
content: Employees receive 24 paid leave days each year. Submit leave requests through the people portal at least five business days before the first day away.

title: Expense claims
content: Expense claims require an itemized receipt and manager approval. Submit claims within 30 days of purchase through the finance portal.

title: Security incidents
content: Report suspected phishing or account compromise to security immediately. Do not forward suspicious messages or reuse an exposed password.
